name: ppoc-pediatric-ehr
title: PPOC Pediatric EHR Data Package
description: Machine-readable schema for de-identified pediatric EHR data. Absolute dates are replaced by patient age in days.

resources.x-keyDescription: No row-level primary key: lab_order_id repeats across result components and result_line_num is blank in some rows.
resources.x-encodingNote: Mixed encoding: predominantly ASCII with a few cp1252 punctuation bytes and a few UTF-8 sequences. iso-8859-1 decodes every byte without error.

resources.name: medications
resources.title: Medications
resources.description: One pediatric prescription, administration, or historical medication record per row.

fields.name: patient_id
fields.description: Blinded unique identifier for the patient.

fields.name: visit_id
fields.description: Blinded unique identifier for the visit.

fields.name: med_record_id
fields.description: Blinded unique identifier for the medication record.

fields.name: med_order_date_age_in_days
fields.description: Patient age in days at medication order, replacing the absolute date for de-identification.

fields.name: med_start_date_age_in_days
fields.description: Patient age in days at medication start, replacing the absolute date for de-identification.

fields.name: med_end_date_age_in_days
fields.description: Patient age in days at medication end, replacing the absolute date for de-identification.

fields.name: med_record_type
fields.description: Internal for a PPOC-provider order; External for a historical or outside record.

fields.name: med_simple_generic_name
fields.description: Simplified generic medication name.

resources.name: problem_list
resources.title: Problem List
resources.description: One patient problem-list diagnosis entry per row.

fields.name: patient_id
fields.description: Blinded unique identifier for the patient.

fields.name: problem_list_id
fields.description: Blinded unique identifier for the problem-list entry.

fields.name: noted_date_age_in_days
fields.description: Patient age in days at first problem notation, replacing the absolute date for de-identification.

fields.name: resolved_date_age_in_days
fields.description: Patient age in days at problem resolution, replacing the absolute date for de-identification.

fields.name: pl_diag
fields.description: Problem-list diagnosis code.

resources.name: referrals
resources.title: Referrals
resources.description: One specialty referral associated with a pediatric visit per row.

fields.name: patient_id
fields.description: Blinded unique identifier for the patient.

fields.name: visit_id
fields.description: Associated visit identifier; nullable when the referral is not linked to a visit.

fields.name: referral_id
fields.description: Blinded unique identifier for the referral.

fields.name: referral_date_age_in_days
fields.description: Patient age in days at referral, replacing the absolute date for de-identification.

fields.name: requested_specialty
fields.description: Requested referral specialty; nullable.

fields.name: referral_number_of_visits
fields.description: Authorized or associated visit count; nullable.
